additional_concerns: No Fund-specific evidence or runtime implementation is supplied. These findings assess the declared representation, not an actual Fund’s classification.

Footnote 7 places holistic discretionary assessment below 50% of NAV. The formula does not expressly encode that context. For consistent known Boolean inputs, threshold OR designation produces the same result as threshold OR (NOT threshold AND designation); the omission does not establish an output defect.

The runtime states: "A conflicting fact anywhere in the rule dependency closure blocks evaluation with CONFLICT even on an unselected branch." This adds an evidentiary restriction absent from the circular: designation conflict can block an independently established automatic-threshold result. Whether this safeguard is intended remains unresolved.

Exposure identification, measurement, aggregation and applicable updates are delegated to supplied facts. No closed-list restriction appears, but no executable assessment of these matters is supplied. The corresponding OMITS findings do not themselves establish defects in the classification Boolean.

Applying the discretionary route requires a Fund-specific SFC designation and evidence of its applicability at the assessment time. Neither is supplied. Missing designation history cannot establish absence.
Effective dates, designation persistence and subsequent amendments are not established. Possible updates must not be treated as established updates.
All three supplied dependency IDs lack source_hash values and identifying descriptions. None qualifies as AVAILABLE or can reliably be mapped to a named missing authority.

Referenced external materials are absent: UT Code section 7.3; the LAF circular refNo=25EC9; Code of Conduct paragraph 5.5; Chapter 6 of the Guidelines on Online Distribution and Advisory Platforms and relevant FAQs; the internal product-approval circular refNo=16EC11; and the advertising guidelines. Their full requirements cannot be assessed, although the narrow claims below are supported directly by this circular.

The 15% direct-investment limit in footnote 1 is separate from the 50% aggregate classification threshold. A negative classification result grants no permission to disregard investment limits, disclosure requirements or distribution duties.
The LAF exclusion concerns the assessed Fund, not every listed closed-ended investment it holds. BDC holdings must not be excluded from exposure merely by conflating these categories.

Home-regulator distribution restrictions are another non-exhaustive designation factor. Neither those restrictions nor the listed Fund and asset characteristics substitute for an actual SFC designation.
The consultation claim’s OBLIGATION/SHOULD metadata could overstate encouragement if interpreted as mandatory. Consultation is not a prerequisite to automatic classification.
OUT_OF_SCOPE does not mean non-complex under another regime. FALSE does not establish overall compliance or unrestricted distribution.
